mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.nickname, u.role, u.status, COALESCE(p.audit_status, '已通过') AS auditStatus FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN professor_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.username = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.nickname, u.role, u.status, u.avatar, u.phone, u.email, COALESCE(p.audit_status, '已通过') AS auditStatus FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN professor_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( username, password, nickname, role, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{user.username}, #{user.password}, #{user.nickname}, #{user.role}, #{user.status}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO professor_profile ( user_id, real_name, audit_status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{realName}, '待审核' )
